notes.title: Zector 7: 2025 Roadmap
notes.content:
Greetings, brave survivors of Zector 7! Fasten your seatbelts (and grab your favorite zombie-slaying gear) because 2025 is shaping up to be our biggest, boldest year yet. We’re thrilled to share a sneak peek at what’s to come. Get ready to explore, survive, and thrive like never before!

[h2]A Whole New World… Times Five![/h2]
Ever wondered what lurks beyond the horizon? Wonder no more! We’ll be adding 5 brand-new biomes for you to scavenge, survive, and uncover hidden stories in. From sun-scorched deserts to mysterious swamplands, each environment promises fresh challenges and treasures galore.

[h2]Polish & Performance (Plus a Dash of TLC)[/h2]
We know every second counts when the undead are after you, so we’re rolling out numerous Quality of Life updates. Expect input mapping (so your controller or keyboard setup feels just right), bug fixes, and performance boosts to keep the action flowing smoothly.

[h2]The Great Hunt Begins[/h2]
Meat’s back on the menu! Our upcoming Hunting Update introduces refined hunting mechanics. Gather resources, track elusive critters, and stave off hunger in style—just watch out for what’s stalking you in return…

[h2]Game Feel Revamp[/h2]
Zombie interactions are about to get a massive overhaul. The Game Feel Update will improve how you battle the undead, making every encounter more intense, immersive, and (dare we say) delightfully terrifying.

[h2]Stats & Settings Overhaul[/h2]
Ever wonder how many steps you’ve taken or how many zombie heads you’ve knocked off? With our Stats & Settings Update, you can keep tabs on your most impressive feats and tweak difficulty options to suit your playstyle. Get ready to personalize your fight for survival like never before.

[h2]UI from the Future[/h2]
We’re giving the entire interface a sci-fi facelift. Expect an in-world, diegetic UI that immerses you in the eerie, high-tech world of Zector 7, so you can manage your stats, settings, and inventory without breaking the apocalyptic atmosphere.

[h2]Ridin’ in Style[/h2]
Got places to be? The upcoming Vehicles Update will introduce new ways to traverse the wasteland. Whether you’re cruising through crumbling highways or mowing down zombies in style, these rides will change how you conquer the frontier.

[h2]Skills & Roles[/h2]
Finally, we’re giving you even more ways to build your character. The Skills & Roles Update will let you choose an occupation with unique perks at the start of each run, plus expanded stats and the ability to grow stronger as you play. Develop your survivor any way you see fit—your survival strategy, your rules!

That’s just a taste of what’s cooking for Zector 7 in 2025. We can’t wait for you to jump in and experience these changes for yourself. Keep your eyes peeled and your wits about you—more details (and surprises) are on the way. Thanks for sticking with us on this wild ride. We’ll see you on the front lines of Zector 7!

Stay safe, stay alive!
– SocksandGoats

notes.title: Today is the day! Zector 7 has officially released into Early Access!
notes.content:
You can now purchase the Early Access version of Zector 7, at a steep discount for a limited time only.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2935280/Zector_7

Come craft, build and fight with your friends in this sci-fi zombie survival adventure.

Current State of the Game:
- There are a few hours of fun at least, especially if you play with friends, but also solo.
- Drive vehicles
- Loot abandoned cars and buildings across the map and in Graveport City
- Buy / Sell items at vendors
- Activate Beacon Towers to slow zombies in the surrounding area and unlock rare loot.

The Road Ahead:
You can view the full roadmap here: https://socksandgoats.com/zector-7/zector-7-roadmap

There is a lot planned for the game including:
- Cyber City (sci-fi city with shops, missions, and more)
- More sci-fi vehicles including hovering and flying vehicles
- Vehicle building and management. You will be able to have a mobile base with storage chests and more inside of your vehicle
- Repeatable Missions to earn credits and rare loot
- Story missions to help you uncover the mysterious of the Zector Corporation and it's experiments
- Sci-fi items and weapons like flamethrowers, laser chainsaw
- Factions with different wants and allegiances that you can fight or team up with.
- New diverse biomes with different creatures and bosses to discover and fight
- and much more...

notes.title: Zector 7: Secrets of Zector 1 Update - Playtest v0.6.0
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Towers around the map with beacons so it's easy to see where you should go
[*] Changed starting location to be in a brand new futuristic science laboratory known as Zector 1. 
[*] Added missions to help get you started and escape Zector 1 facility.
[*] Added enemies within Zector 1
[*] Added Vending Machine so you can spend your hard-earned credits on fancy loot
[*] Added Luma Capsule, a small holdable & throwable capsule that lights up the surrounding area in a neon glow
[*] Added Beacon placement building that helps you identify your base and doubles as a "Cupboard", which allows you to stake a claim of a certain area, preventing others from building there.
[*] Added more ponds and lakes to make it easier to find drinkable water
[*] Added more lootable cars and houses around the map
[*] Added futuristic lootable vehicles
[*] Added tiered loot system so you can get more common loot from things like enemies and cars and more rare items in places you'd expect to find them. It also spawns random items within that tier so different playthroughs will get different items.
[*] Added Automated Door system with locking/unlocking via Computer Panels, which enables some interesting mechanics in the Zector facilities.
[*] Redesigned almost every UI screen to have new fonts, colors and animations.
[*] Added Feedback form so players can leave in-game feedback easily by hitting F12 or selecting it in the Pause Menu
[*] Added Controls screen to easily see Input Controls in the Pause Menu
[*] Added basic Controller support to player movement (UI still requires a mouse)
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed main currency to be called Credits and look like Coins. Cash is now Old World Money and is worth very little.
[*] Added title of Crafting station you are interacting with to UI (ie. Workbench now says "Workbench" instead of "Crafting")
[*] Updated Thirst & Hunger to go down 75% slower
[*] Increased Stamina regen by 100%
[*] Reduced amount of stamina certain actions like punching cost
[*] Added better SFX for campfire
[*] Fence wall recipe in Workbench now crafts 4 Fence Walls for the same cost
[*] Fence Walls now stack up to 20
[*] Added same water component to rivers that lakes/ponds have, which allows SFX and VFX when interacting with water. (Still working on making them drinkable)
[*] Made the pond in the starter area easier to find
[*] Removed metal scrap from Repair Bench recipe so it's easier to craft
[*] Added more crashed ships and metal barrels around the map so it's easier to find Metal Scrap
[*] Added a lot of UI text to Localization to make it easier to Localize in the future.
[*] Started adding unique Names to items with interesting descriptions to give the game more character.
[*] Reduced Take All button SFX
[*] Reduced Torch brightness by 50%
[*] Added Inventory controls to UI when inventory is open
[*] Removed all starter weapons from player on respawn
[*] Added lake at the bottom of the river in the mountain biome
[*] Increased Wood stack to 20
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed campfire interact text
[*] Fixed Fence wall icon
[*] Fixed issue with Cupboard not crafting
[*] Fixed some trees not having collisions
[*] Fixed eating playing drinking SFX
[*] Fixed bandages SFX so they have their own unique sound now
[*] Fixed "Strange Signal" mission so now you can complete it by going to the marker.
[*] Fixed issue with View Sensitivity in Pause Menu
[*] Fixed "Craft a Workbench" mission
[*] Fixed Ammo type bug that made it so you couldn't reload certain weapons
[*] Fixed container bug that was duplicating items for clients
[*] Fixed AI Spawner issue that was spawning a lot more enemies than it was supposed to
[*] Removed Gate that was duplicating from another part of the map
[*] Fixed Survivor Skill tree that prevented player from unlocking past 3
[*] Fixed Audio issues where audio was only playing on Host and not Client
[*] Fixed bow not reloading on clients
[/list]


If you want to join up with others or leave feedback, you can join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/t7ZYSXvXCE
